# The engine matrix's row list (#670): one Docker Engine line per row,
# spelled as the `docker:<tag>-dind` tag suffix.
#
# ONE DECLARATION, READ TWICE. .github/workflows/engine-matrix.yml builds
# its matrix from this file, and scripts/engine-floor.sh requires a row
# for every line in it before it will reconcile a floor. That is what
# makes a vanished cell a red lane instead of a smaller matrix: a cell
# that dies before it uploads its row leaves a tag here with no row, and
# the reconciliation refuses.
#
# Tags, not exact versions: `29` follows 29.x, and a row naming 29.7.2
# would measure a frozen engine while the point of the weekly run is to
# notice the moving one. 20.10 and 19.03 are spelled with their minors
# because those lines have no bare-major tag.
#
# THE LIST IS DOWNWARD-OPEN ON PURPOSE. It does not stop at the engines
# we expect to pass: a matrix whose every row passes has measured the
# list, not the floor. scripts/engine-floor.sh refuses a list whose
# lowest row is the declared floor for that reason.
29
28
27
26
25
24
23
20.10
19.03
